scene_summary: Two separated, softly textured figurative groupings float on a largely uninterrupted teal-green ground. The larger left grouping contains a pale face, a gray animal-like companion and enclosing pale arms amid ragged blue-white folds. A broad cobalt garment fold sits directly beneath the arms. The smaller right grouping pairs a pale face with a pointed blue animal-like head above trailing pale-blue paint.
usable_surfaces: Cobalt garment fold bounded by cloudy white trim and the underside of a bent pale arm

detected_objects.label: A broad cobalt fold with cloudy white edges beneath a bent pale arm
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A saturated cobalt-blue basin-shaped fold is clearly visible in the lower-left portion of the large grouping. Its upper edge curves beneath the pale enclosing arm and a lighter blue fold; a descending pale hand bounds its right side. Uneven cloudy white trim traces the lower edge, with a pointed blue extension rising along the left edge. The polygon follows this single garment mark rather than enclosing the entire figure or its trailing paint.

complexity_assessment.rationale: Two isolated figurative islands sit against one expansive teal ground. Their interiors have intricate ragged texture and recognizable faces, but the overall composition remains sparse and painterly rather than cluttered. Only the planned cobalt fold is mapped; the smaller grouping remains a subordinate visual echo.
